verifications.note: Page dated 21.02.2024 names Kraftwerk Weiher in Quierschied and Iqony.

Latest Activity.note: A municipal news item of 21 February 2024 reports that Iqony still plans a modern hydrogen-ready gas plant at the Weiher site, but is waiting for the federal tender rules. I found no newer dated report specific to this site.

Status Detail.value: Iqony plans a hydrogen-ready gas plant at the site but has not announced a design, permit or tender bid.
Status Detail.note: Based on the municipal news item of 21 February 2024.

units.notes: Status stays announced. I found no technology, turbine maker, capacity or start year in any readable document. The municipal item names the site and Iqony but gives no technical data. A freedom of information request to the Saarland government about technical data was passed to the mining authority in May 2026 and has no answer yet.

qa.recommendation: Check the public freedom of information request for an answer later.
qa.note: A public request on FragDenStaat, filed 28 May 2026, asks the Saarland ministry for technical data on the planned Quierschied-Weiher gas plant. It was passed to the state mining authority and had no reply when I looked.

monitor.note: Watch the capacity tender results due by 3 November 2026 and any Iqony announcement for Quierschied. A trade press survey of 18 August 2026 says Iqony declined to comment on joining the first round.
